title: Jailer 2 Crosses Rs 300 Crore Worldwide on Day 3 as Saturday Collections Jump
excerpt: Rajinikanth's sequel reached the milestone in its opening weekend, with trade estimates putting the three-day worldwide gross at Rs 317-321 crore and overseas markets contributing close to half the total.
body:
• Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 crossed Rs 300 crore worldwide on Day 3, its third day in theatres, according to trade estimates reported by NDTV and Sacnilk.
  • Sacnilk puts the worldwide gross at about Rs 321 crore in three days, making Jailer 2 the third Tamil film of 2026 to cross Rs 300 crore and the second-highest-grossing Tamil release of the year.
  • NDTV, citing Sacnilk figures, reports Day 3 India net of Rs 47.80 crore, India net of Rs 144.60 crore in three days, and overseas gross of Rs 147.50 crore, for a worldwide total of Rs 317.15 crore.
  • All figures are trade estimates, not audited producer numbers, and trackers differ by several crore on the worldwide total.

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 crossed the Rs 300 crore mark worldwide on Saturday, its third day in theatres. The Nelson Dilipkumar-directed sequel passed the milestone during its opening weekend, driven by a Saturday recovery in India and an overseas gross that accounts for close to half of its worldwide total. For Tamil cinema audiences in India and across the diaspora, the run confirms the 2023 Jailer audience has returned for the sequel at scale.

Day 3: the Saturday jump

The new development on Day 3 was growth, not just accumulation. NDTV reports the film collected Rs 47.80 crore net in India on Saturday across 14,604 shows, a 28.8% increase over its Day 2 net of Rs 37.10 crore. The film had opened at Rs 59.70 crore net in India on Day 1. After three days, its India net stands at Rs 144.60 crore and its India gross at Rs 169.65 crore, per the figures NDTV cites from Sacnilk.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=Y9giQm_Nd7A

Sacnilk's own report frames the Saturday rise in gross terms: India gross rose 27.4% from Friday to Rs 55.35 crore on Day 3. That rebound matters because it points to weekend demand beyond the opening-day rush, with the film holding a wide theatrical presence across the southern states.

Two worldwide totals, one milestone

Trackers differ on the exact worldwide number. NDTV reports a worldwide gross of Rs 317.15 crore in three days, built from India gross of Rs 169.65 crore and cumulative overseas gross of Rs 147.50 crore, with overseas adding Rs 47.50 crore on Day 3 alone. Sacnilk's report puts the worldwide gross higher, at approximately Rs 321 crore, with an estimated Rs 152 crore from overseas, about 48.5% of its global total. Sacnilk breaks the overseas run down as Rs 57 crore on Thursday, Rs 43 crore on Friday and Rs 52 crore on Saturday.

Both totals are trade estimates. Box office trackers compile figures from theatre reporting and distributor estimates, totals vary between trackers, and producers have not published an audited three-day figure in either report. Readers should treat Rs 317-321 crore as an estimated range, with the Rs 300 crore crossing itself agreed by both sources.

Third Tamil film of 2026 past Rs 300 crore

Sacnilk says Jailer 2 is the third Tamil film of 2026 to cross Rs 300 crore worldwide, after Vijay's Jana Nayagan and Suriya's Karuppu, and that it reached the mark faster than any Tamil film this year, tied with Rajinikanth's Coolie. On Sacnilk's chart, Jailer 2 at Rs 321 crore in three days has moved ahead of Karuppu at Rs 310.10 crore to become the second-highest-grossing Tamil release of 2026, behind Jana Nayagan at Rs 324.70 crore. Sunday's collections could change that order.

NDTV adds a career benchmark: at Rs 317 crore-plus, the sequel has passed the lifetime worldwide totals of Rajinikanth's Kabali, at about Rs 295 crore, and Enthiran, at about Rs 290 crore, making it his fourth-highest-grossing film worldwide on reported figures. It remains behind 2.0, at an estimated Rs 668-675 crore, the first Jailer, at about Rs 605-630 crore, and Coolie, at Rs 516.7-548 crore.

The film and what comes next

Jailer 2, a Sun Pictures production directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, brings Rajinikanth back as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, the character introduced in the 2023 Jailer. The ensemble cast includes Mohanlal, Shivarajkumar, Ramya Krishnan, Vijay Sethupathi, Vidya Balan and Mithun Chakraborty, with music by Anirudh Ravichander. For diaspora audiences, the overseas share is the story within the story: an international gross close to half the worldwide total in three days reflects Rajinikanth's drawing power in overseas Tamil markets as much as in Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala and Andhra Pradesh-Telangana. The next test is Sunday, the final day of the opening weekend, and whether the film closes the small gap to Jana Nayagan at the top of the 2026 Tamil chart.
